## Callback-interface candidates ("subclass me")

Direction is Dart calls JS. `fire` = void, fire-and-forget; `async` = returns a Future; `sync` = returns a value synchronously; `builder` = returns a Widget; `opaque` = an argument cannot be encoded (Canvas, RenderObject, ...).

Verdicts: sync-return 21, never 35, async-ok 8, builder 2 (of 66).
